seed_expert_discoveries.technical_takeaway: New public beta for multiagent orchestration: lead agent creates phased plans executed across multiple agents with result combination for complex workloads.
Exploration of feed-based interfaces for agentic workflows to reduce prompting burden and enable discovery/approval of actions like drafted emails or updates.

global_discoveries.technical_takeaway: New model series for personal/professional agents with SOTA on agent benchmarks (SWE-Marathon 57.5, AutomationBench 45.4, MemoryBench 85.5); features Active Memory for cross-conversation context and Active Focus for goal persistence in multi-step tasks.
Curated list of 10 repos for persistent memory in agents including Mem0, Hindsight, memU, Cognee, Graphiti, OpenViking for long-term recall and context management.

Paper shows three-tier chain-of-agents with persistent trace-recall reduces peak KV cache to 14.3 MiB (vs 35 MiB baseline) while maintaining accuracy; highlights efficiency in long-context work via memory patterns.

near_misses.technical_takeaway: New Agent Learning/Data Services to capture failed sessions, convert to tests, and debug production agents before widespread impact.
near_misses.reason: Practical tool for agent reliability but more product announcement than core technical innovation or benchmark.

notes: Limited high-signal technical posts from seed experts in 24h window; global search surfaced strong agent/memory focused updates. No major new frameworks/repos beyond memory lists.
